I am a curious Machine Learning Engineer who writes about different practical and theorical technical problems I encounter about during my day job. I also do research sometimes, and expose some of those ideas here. 

More formally, the [blog](blog.qmd) is where I work through ideas in a long-form explanations, half-formed intuitions, diagrams that took longer than the math. The [research](research.qmd) page is the formal record of my research.
